# Surefire exclude patterns for the subscription-util-blocking shard in maven.yml. They leave out the
# stream-catchup-subscription test classes that the stream-catchup-blocking shard runs with -Dtest, so
# keep this pattern and that one naming the same classes. An excludes file adds to Surefire's default
# includes and excludes instead of replacing them, which -Dtest would do.
%regex[.*/StreamCatchup[A-R][^/]*]
